portal.heroSubtitle: ഹോം ഷെഫുകൾ, ടിഫിൻ സേവനങ്ങൾ, ഡെലിവറി മാത്രം അടുക്കളകൾ എന്നിവയ്ക്കായുള്ള വളർച്ചാ ഓപ്പറേറ്റിംഗ് സിസ്റ്റം — വാട്ട്‌സ്ആപ്പ് ഓർഡറുകൾ, തത്സമയ ക്യാപ്‌ചർ മെനുകൾ, സീറോ ഫുഡ് കമ്മീഷൻ.
portal.appsBody: കസ്റ്റമർ ആപ്പിൽ ഉപഭോക്താക്കൾ ഓർഡർ ചെയ്യുന്നു. ഉടമകൾ അടുക്കള ആപ്പിൽ എല്ലാം പ്രവർത്തിപ്പിക്കുന്നു - റിപ്പോർട്ടുകൾക്കായി WhatsApp, ഭക്ഷണ കമ്മീഷൻ ഇല്ല.
portal.featuresTitle: ക്ലൗഡ് കിച്ചണുകൾ യഥാർത്ഥത്തിൽ എങ്ങനെ പ്രവർത്തിക്കുന്നു എന്നതിനാണ് നിർമ്മിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നത്
portal.featuresBody: WhatsApp-ആദ്യ പ്രവർത്തനങ്ങൾ, സത്യസന്ധമായ മെനുകൾ, ഉടമ നിയന്ത്രണം - എല്ലാ ഓർഡറിനും കമ്മീഷൻ നൽകാതെ.
portal.featureWhatsappDesc: ചാറ്റ് സന്ദേശങ്ങൾ ഘടനാപരമായ ഓർഡറുകളാക്കി മാറ്റുക. ഒറ്റ ടാപ്പിൽ ഡ്രാഫ്റ്റുകൾ സ്ഥിരീകരിക്കുക.
portal.featureLiveDesc: ഹീറോ ഡിഷ് ഫോട്ടോകൾ തത്സമയം ക്യാപ്‌ചർ ചെയ്യപ്പെടുന്നതിനാൽ ഉപഭോക്താക്കൾ അവർ ഓർഡർ ചെയ്യുന്നത് വിശ്വസിക്കുന്നു.
portal.featureBrandDesc: നിങ്ങളുടെ ബ്രാൻഡ്, മെനു, ചെക്ക്ഔട്ട് - /k/your-code-ൽ പങ്കിടാനാകുന്ന ഒരു സ്റ്റോർഫ്രണ്ട് പ്രസിദ്ധീകരിക്കുക.
portal.featureGoldenDesc: നിങ്ങളുടെ മികച്ച പാചക ദിനങ്ങളും പാചകക്കുറിപ്പുകളും പിൻ ചെയ്യാൻ ML റേറ്റിംഗുകളും അഭിപ്രായങ്ങളും വായിക്കുന്നു.
portal.featureStreamDesc: ചേരുവകൾ → തയ്യാറാക്കൽ → തയ്യാറാക്കി തത്സമയം പോകൂ, അങ്ങനെ ഉപഭോക്താക്കൾക്ക് യഥാർത്ഥ വിഭവം കാണാം.
portal.featureTemplatesDesc: നിങ്ങളുടെ അടുക്കളയുടെ ഉടമസ്ഥതയിലുള്ള - ദൈനംദിന മെനുവിനും CRM-നും വേണ്ടി WhatsApp, ഇമെയിൽ ടെംപ്ലേറ്റുകൾ സൃഷ്ടിക്കുക.
portal.featureLifecycleDesc: സ്റ്റാറ്റസ് അപ്‌ഡേറ്റുകൾക്കൊപ്പം സ്വീകരിച്ചത് മുതൽ ഡെലിവറി വരെയുള്ള എല്ലാ ഓർഡറുകളും ട്രാക്ക് ചെയ്യുക.
portal.featureDashboardDesc: മെനുകൾ, ഓർഡറുകൾ, വാട്ട്‌സ്ആപ്പ് & പേയ്‌മെൻ്റുകൾ, ടെംപ്ലേറ്റുകൾ, വളർച്ച - ഒരു അടുക്കള ജോലിസ്ഥലം.
portal.howBody: രജിസ്‌ട്രേഷൻ മുതൽ നിങ്ങളുടെ ആദ്യത്തെ വാട്ട്‌സ്ആപ്പ് ഓർഡർ വരെ അഞ്ച് മിനിറ്റിനുള്ളിൽ.
portal.how1Desc: ഒരു ഉടമയായി സൈൻ അപ്പ് ചെയ്യുക, OTP പരിശോധിച്ചുറപ്പിക്കുക, നിങ്ങളുടെ ക്ലൗഡ് അടുക്കള പ്രൊഫൈൽ സൃഷ്ടിക്കുക.
portal.how2Desc: തത്സമയ ഫോട്ടോകൾക്കൊപ്പം വിഭവങ്ങൾ ചേർക്കുക. നിങ്ങളുടെ ഉപഭോക്തൃ മെനു ലിങ്ക് പങ്കിടുക.
portal.how3Desc: WhatsApp ഓർഡറുകൾ സ്വീകരിക്കുക, ജീവിതചക്രം നിയന്ത്രിക്കുക, ആവർത്തിച്ചുള്ള ഉപഭോക്താക്കളെ വളർത്തുക.
portal.pricingBody: ഒരു ഫ്ലാറ്റ് പ്രതിമാസ ഫീസ് അടയ്ക്കുക. നിങ്ങളുടെ ഭക്ഷണ വരുമാനത്തിൻ്റെ 100% സൂക്ഷിക്കുക. നിങ്ങളുടെ അടുക്കള വളരുമ്പോൾ സ്കെയിൽ ചെയ്യുക.
portal.pricingNote: എല്ലാ പ്ലാനുകളിലും ഓർഡർ ലൈഫ് സൈക്കിൾ, ലൈവ് ക്യാപ്‌ചർ മെനുകൾ, കസ്റ്റമർ മെനു ലിങ്കുകൾ എന്നിവ ഉൾപ്പെടുന്നു. പൈലറ്റ് അടുക്കളകൾക്ക് ഓൺബോർഡിംഗ് പിന്തുണ ലഭിക്കുന്നു. ഓർഡറുകളിൽ മറഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്ന ഫീസ് ഇല്ല.
portal.planStarterDesc: അവരുടെ ആദ്യത്തെ ക്ലൗഡ് കിച്ചൺ സമാരംഭിക്കുന്ന ഹോം ഷെഫുകൾക്ക് അനുയോജ്യമാണ്.
portal.planGrowthDesc: ആവർത്തിച്ചുള്ള ഉപഭോക്താക്കളും വരുമാനവും വർദ്ധിപ്പിക്കാൻ തയ്യാറായ അടുക്കളകൾക്കായി.
portal.supportBody: ചുവടെയുള്ള പതിവ് ചോദ്യങ്ങൾ ബ്രൗസ് ചെയ്യുക അല്ലെങ്കിൽ ഞങ്ങളുടെ AI അസിസ്റ്റൻ്റുമായി ചാറ്റ് ചെയ്യുക - മൂലയിലുള്ള ചാറ്റ് ബട്ടൺ ഉപയോഗിച്ച് ഉടമയെയോ ഉപഭോക്താവിനെയോ തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കുക.
portal.contactBody: നിങ്ങളുടെ അടുക്കളയെക്കുറിച്ച് ഞങ്ങളോട് പറയുക. തത്സമയം പോകാൻ ഞങ്ങൾ നിങ്ങളെ സഹായിക്കും.
portal.tileAdminBody: Kitchens, employees, tickets, packages, and API keys — Super Admin only.
portal.tileCustomerBody: Nearby kitchens, live-capture menus, honest ETAs, and fair delivery fees.
portal.tileKitchenBody: WhatsApp orders, menu, tiffin plans, reports — zero food commission.

identity.complete: Identity on file — photos, Aadhaar, and PAN are saved.
identity.hint: A profile photo plus a live camera photo, Aadhaar, and PAN — so support can match you when money or kitchen status is in question.
identity.idsHint: Numbers are stored for support matching. You will only see a masked value after save.
identity.idsRequired: Enter Aadhaar or PAN to update.
identity.incomplete: Add a profile photo, a live photo, Aadhaar, and PAN to complete identity.
identity.livePhotoHint: Open the camera and capture now. Gallery uploads are not accepted.
identity.liveRequired: Live photo must be captured with the camera.
identity.profilePhotoHint: Gallery or camera. This is your display photo.
identity.title: Your identity

tour.s1Body: Home shows orders in progress. Open Orders to accept, cook, and mark ready — never fake a timer.
tour.s2Body: Add Dish uses the camera. Gallery stock photos are not allowed as the hero. Customers trust the plate they see.
tour.s3Body: Ingredients → pantry → dish quantities. This drives stock, health score, and calories.
tour.s4Body: Kitchen setup: free radius and max km must match how far you actually ride. Then share your kitchen code.
tour.s10Body: Tiffin: combo plans need ≥2 dishes; single-dish = 1. Templates: WhatsApp/email copy for CRM segments (package-gated). Stream: opt-in go-live with dish phases ingredients → prep → prepared. Never dump a publisher token on screen.
tour.s11Body:
WhatsApp: your kitchen phone_number_id. Super Admin holds the Meta app secret — do not paste it here.

Payment gateway: kitchen Razorpay / Route keys, not SaaS Razorpay. Settlements list splits for your kitchen.
tour.s12Body: GST: year selector, monthly report, Excel/PDF export. Bill ids look like {your-code}-BILL-YYYYMMDD-SEQ. You close the monthly audit when the books match.
tour.s13Body:
Setup: name, street, map pin stay editable. Code never changes. Set free radius and max km you actually ride. Identity: live photo + Aadhaar + PAN (masked for support).

Brand: public page /k/YOURCODE. Share that link on WhatsApp.
tour.s14Body: Subscription is owner SaaS — zero per-order food commission. Referrals: your owner code and leads. Learning / Community unlock with package traction. You are done — use the left nav and the What you can do here list on every page.
tour.s5Body:
Ingredients is the pantry. Add SKUs, set stock, set kcal per 100g (or per piece).

Open a dish recipe: grams above the controls. Save. The running plate kcal and health score fill from the map. Healthy appears only when the map is complete, kcal is under the Super Admin cap (default 500), and the score meets the floor. You cannot pin Healthy by hand.
tour.s6Body:
Bulk prep has two modes. Order Ready: first time you mark an order Ready, pantry drops once — Accept does not deduct. Bulk prep only: stock drops when you Mark prepared on a batch, not on Ready.

Create a combo batch (≥2 dishes), save qty, Mark prepared, watch stock fall.
tour.s7Body: Reports: pick 6 months after a bulk seed. Revenue, top dishes, peak hours, diner segments. 90/180-day views roll up. There is no platform food-commission % — kitchCU is a subscription.
tour.s8Body: Ratings show aggregates after delivered orders. Empty is honest if nobody has rated yet. You do not edit a diner’s score.
tour.s9Body: CRM is your diner book: search, sort Spend / Orders / Name, VIP / Repeat chips. Coupons: create a code, set active, diners apply at checkout. Offers belong to this kitchen — not a platform sale of your list.

addDish.s1: Name, price, category, honest prep and delivery minutes.
addDish.s2: Hero must be live-capture (camera). Gallery stock photos are blocked as hero.
addDish.s3: Optional calories note sits next to recipe kcal — it does not replace the pantry map.
addDish.s4: Save. Without a live hero the dish stays inactive.
addDish.s5: Then open Ingredients and map the recipe so stock, health, and kcal work.
addDish.title: What you can do on Add dish

brand.s1: Edit the public storefront name, story, and photos for /k/YOURCODE.
brand.s2: Open the customer link and confirm diners see the same brand and live menu.
brand.s3: Share the code on WhatsApp. Deep links do not need an app store.
brand.s4: Kitchen code on this page is display-only — change address on Setup, not the code.
brand.title: What you can do on Brand
brand.s5: Hero images on dishes still come from Menu live-capture — Brand art is the storefront frame, not a stock-photo dish.

community.s2: Submit or appreciate when your package allows.
community.s3: No 500 splash. Cover images are optional.
community.title: What you can do on Community
community.s4: A community recipe is inspiration — you still add it on Menu with your own live hero.
community.s5: Rankings are platform-wide; they do not change this kitchen’s cook-line.

coupons.s1: Create a code, discount, and active window.
coupons.s3: Diners apply the code at checkout. Invalid codes error, they do not crash.
coupons.s4: Coupons belong to this kitchen only.
coupons.title: What you can do on Coupons
coupons.s5: Turn a code off instead of deleting when a campaign ends so history stays readable.

crm.s1: Search diners. Sort Spend, Orders, or Name.
crm.s2: VIP / Repeat / Tagged chips filter your book.
crm.s3: Open a diner for history. This list is kitchen-scoped — never another kitchen’s customers.
crm.s4: After a 6-month seed, CKPNQ001 must not look empty.
crm.title: What you can do on CRM
crm.s5: Coupons and templates send to segments from this book — you own the CRM, kitchCU does not sell it.

growth.s1: Open suggestions, combos, and patterns from real orders.
growth.s2: Empty is fine on a new kitchen. A crash is a fail.
growth.s3: Package-gated: locked state is OK until you upgrade.
growth.title: What you can do on Growth
growth.s4: Use a suggested combo as a hint — still create the dish with a live hero on Menu.
growth.s5: Daily menu WhatsApp push (if entitled) uses this kitchen’s live dishes only.

gst.s1: Pick the invoice year that matches seeded or live invoices.
gst.s2: Sync, open the monthly report, export Excel or PDF.
gst.s3: Bill numbers are {kitchen-code}-BILL-YYYYMMDD-SEQ. GST docs use {code}-GST-YYYYMM-SEQ.
gst.s4: Close the monthly audit when the snapshot is right. Super Admin can export from the kitchen GST tab.
gst.title: What you can do on GST

home.s1: Read kitchen name + code, plan pill, drafts and in-progress counts.
home.s2: Open Orders for the cook line, or New order for a walk-in / phone ticket.
home.s3: Add Dish with the camera, or Brand to share /k/your-code.
home.s4: Replay the full dashboard tour with Show tips (top right).
home.s5: Collapse this list once you know the page — it stays on every screen.
home.title: What you can do on Home

ingredients.s1: Add pantry SKUs. Adjust stock +100 / −10 and confirm the number updates.
ingredients.s2: Set kcal per 100g or per piece. Low stock chip hides healthy rows.
ingredients.s3: Select a dish. Ingredient / qty / unit sit above the controls in one row.
ingredients.s4: Save recipe. Running plate kcal and health score update. Reload must persist.
ingredients.s5: Healthy tag appears only when the map is complete, kcal ≤ Control cap, score ≥ floor.
ingredients.s6: Optional dish calories note saves with the recipe and shows next to kcal for diners.
ingredients.title: What you can do on Ingredients

learning.s2: Empty or locked is OK. A 500 splash is a fail.
learning.s3: Dish trials invite diners without polluting live ratings.
learning.title: What you can do on Learning
learning.s4: Promote a trial dish to the live menu only after a live-capture hero exists.
learning.s5: Trials are this kitchen’s — another owner cannot see your invite list.

menu.s1: Search, sort, highlight and diet chips. Count updates as you filter.
menu.s2: Live dishes show a live-capture hero. No-hero drafts stay off the diner menu.
menu.s3: Edit price, times, calories note. You cannot pin Healthy — it is automatic from the recipe.
menu.s4: Add dish opens the camera path for the hero.
menu.s5: Inactive dishes are for you only until a live photo is saved.
menu.title: What you can do on Menu

newOrder.s1: Pick live (active) dishes only — drafts without a hero are not on this list.
newOrder.s2: Enter diner phone (and name if asked). Invalid phones are rejected before place.
newOrder.s3: Place. The ticket appears in Active as received.
newOrder.s4: Open it and walk the status machine. Do not invent a 10-minute delivery race.
newOrder.s5: Use this for walk-in / phone. WhatsApp drafts confirm from the Drafts tab.
newOrder.title: What you can do on New order

orders.s1: Search diner or bill. Sort Newest / name. Tabs Active, All, Drafts.
orders.s2: Filter status, source, and 90 / 180 days so six-month history still shows.
orders.s3: Open a ticket. Advance accepted → preparing → ready → out for delivery → delivered.
orders.s4: Cancel leaves Active and appears under All / cancelled. Do not skip backwards except cancel.
orders.s5: New order places a received ticket. Draft remap is off until a matched item is chosen.
orders.s6: Ready may deduct pantry once (Order Ready mode). Accept never deducts stock.
orders.title: What you can do on Orders

payments.s1: Fill kitchen Razorpay / Route fields (not platform SaaS Razorpay).
payments.s2: Settlements list with status filter when money has moved.
payments.s3: Refunds to diners need their Account UPI. You request; they are not a commission clawback.
payments.s4: Super Admin Payments tab on the kitchen workspace is the ops view of the same keys.
payments.title: What you can do on Payment gateway

prep.s1: Mode Order Ready: orders deduct pantry the first time you mark Ready.
prep.s2: Mode Bulk prep only: Ready does not deduct. Only Mark prepared deducts.
prep.s3: Create a combo batch (≥2 dishes, portions > 0). Table shows ingredient lines.
prep.s4: Edit qty → save. Mark prepared → status prepared and stock falls.
prep.s5: Repeat Ready on the same order must not double-deduct.
prep.title: What you can do on Bulk prep

ratings.s1: Read home-taste and quality aggregates per dish.
ratings.s2: Empty state is allowed when this kitchen has no delivered ratings yet.
ratings.s3: You cannot edit a diner’s score. Tips after delivery are theirs.
ratings.title: What you can do on Ratings
ratings.s4: Tips after delivery belong to the diner. Do not chase a fake 5-star from this screen.
ratings.s5: Low scores are a recipe/live-photo signal — fix the plate on Menu / Ingredients, not the number.

referrals.s3: Rewards are dual (customer ↔ kitchen) — Super Admin sets amounts.
referrals.title: What you can do on Referrals
referrals.s4: You cannot approve another kitchen’s lead from this page.
referrals.s5: If amounts look wrong, that is Control / Referrals on Super Admin, not a kitchen setting.

reports.s1: Choose 6 months (or 90 / 180 days). Charts roll up — not unreadable daily bars.
reports.s2: Read revenue, top dishes, peak hours, diner segments (repeat / VIP).
reports.s3: Period-over-period hides if the prior window is empty — that is honest, not a crash.
reports.s4: There is no platform commission % of food. Subscription is Your plan.
reports.title: What you can do on Reports
reports.s5: After a bulk seed, pick the seeded year so history is not empty. Export stays on GST for invoices.

setup.s1: Edit name, street, city, and map pin. Save. Code does not change.
setup.s2: Set free delivery radius and max km you actually ride.
setup.s3: Identity: live photo + Aadhaar + PAN. Support sees masked values.
setup.s4: Delivery payer: owner in-range vs diner extended — honest fees, no fake ETAs.
setup.s5: This is also where sales Train ticks ‘profile is true’ and ‘radius’.
setup.s6: Log out and back in: the same kitchen context should return.
setup.title: What you can do on Setup

stream.s1: Opt in. Go live with a dish and phases: ingredients → prep → prepared.
stream.s2: Diners filter Live now on the customer app.
stream.s3: No publisher token on this screen. Super Admin Streaming tab is summary only.
stream.s4: Module-gated. Locked if streaming is off.
stream.title: What you can do on Live stream
stream.s5: End the session when plating is done so ‘Live now’ does not lie.

subscription.s1: Read the current SaaS tier. This is how kitchCU is paid.
subscription.s2: There is no per-order food commission line. If you see one, file a defect.
subscription.s3: Billing issues go to Super Admin — not this page’s order board.
subscription.title: What you can do on Your plan
subscription.s4: Upgrade unlocks Growth / CRM / stream / learning when Super Admin mapped those features.
subscription.s5: Referral credits (if any) apply on the next subscription charge, not on food tickets.

templates.s1: List WhatsApp and email templates. Dropdowns use the themed chevron.
templates.s2: Send to a CRM segment when the broadcast module is on.
templates.s3: You never paste Meta app secrets here — that is Super Admin API Keys.
templates.title: What you can do on Templates
templates.s4: Preview copy before send. Broadcasts are this kitchen’s customers only.
templates.s5: Package-gated: locked Templates in the nav means upgrade or ask Super Admin to enable marketing_broadcast.

tiffin.s1: Combo plans need ≥2 dishes. Single-dish plans use exactly 1.
tiffin.s2: List, edit, and pause plans. Customer request / accept is the diner path.
tiffin.s3: Module-gated: locked if tiffin is off on your package.
tiffin.title: What you can do on Tiffin
tiffin.s4: Each plan dish must be live (hero + active) or diners will not see it.
tiffin.s5: Pausing a plan stops new requests; it does not cancel cook-line tickets already received.

whatsapp.s1: Confirm the kitchen phone_number_id Super Admin assigned.
whatsapp.s2: Never paste the Meta app secret or verify token here.
whatsapp.s3: Drafts from WhatsApp appear on Orders → Drafts.
whatsapp.s4: Sales staff can only tick Train that you completed this check — they cannot store platform secrets.
whatsapp.title: What you can do on WhatsApp

pageDesc.addDish: Live-capture hero for a single dish — or bulk import from Excel with mapped photos.
pageDesc.brand: Your kitchen-first storefront — logo, hero, menu, cart, checkout.
pageDesc.community: Share recipes, earn reward points, climb chef rankings.
pageDesc.coupons: Share codes on WhatsApp or run targeted dish pricing.
pageDesc.crm: Spend, favorites and order patterns — synced from your orders.
pageDesc.growth: Actionable suggestions, dish combos, and daily menu WhatsApp push.
pageDesc.gst: Register your GSTIN, sync tax invoices from delivered orders, and close monthly audits.
pageDesc.ingredients: Each dish ingredient maps to a pantry SKU and quantity. Plate calories sum from quantity × pantry kcal.
pageDesc.learning: Browse curated recipes, learn dishes, and run sample trials.
pageDesc.newOrder: Walk-in, phone, or counter orders — add dishes and place instantly.
pageDesc.payments: Razorpay keys for this kitchen — customer checkout and Route settlements. No food commission.
pageDesc.prep: Cook once for many portions — expand recipes, edit totals, deduct inventory when prepared.
pageDesc.ratings: Home-taste scores from delivered orders, plus customer dish suggestions.
pageDesc.reports: Revenue trends, best sellers, peak hours, and customer retention.
pageDesc.setup: Your identity, kitchen profile, delivery radius, and who pays when customers are beyond range.
pageDesc.setupNew: Identify yourself, then set up your cloud kitchen to start taking orders.
pageDesc.stream: Name the stream and choose the dish you are cooking. Diners follow ingredients → prep → prepared.
pageDesc.subscription: No per-order commission — flat kitchen SaaS billing only.
pageDesc.templates: Reusable WhatsApp and email copy for CRM blasts — personalize with named variables.
pageDesc.tiffin: Combo packs (2+ dishes) or a single-dish monthly subscription. Customers request — you accept or deny. No food commission.
pageDesc.trial: Trial dish — inactive on the public menu until you promote it.
pageDesc.whatsapp: Connect your Meta phone number ID so customer WhatsApp orders land in this kitchen.

orders.lede: Track, rate, and reorder home meals from kitchens you trust.

dashboard.subtitle: Orders, addresses, and support — simple tools for everyday ordering.
dashboard.tipsEmpty: Order a few home meals — light walk and water tips will show up here.
dashboard.healthEmpty: Order a mapped home meal to see a plate score. Unmapped recipes show after the kitchen links ingredients.
dashboard.healthIntro: Score comes from each kitchen’s recipe map (quantity-weighted). Benefits and cautions are typical home-kitchen use — not medical advice.
dashboard.healthTitle: Ingredient health of food you ordered
dashboard.checkupAsk: Show only food you can have, from kitchens that cook those plates?
dashboard.checkupDisclaimer: Not a diagnosis or treatment plan. Confirm with your clinician.
dashboard.checkupEmpty: No checkup on file yet. A text PDF parses best.
dashboard.checkupIntro: Upload a text PDF of your latest lab report (or a photo plus a short summary). We parse it with an on-device-style ML model to suggest home plates — this is not medical advice.
dashboard.checkupNeedFile: Choose a PDF or photo first.
dashboard.checkupNotesHint: Example: HbA1c 8.2, type 2 diabetes. Optional when the PDF has selectable text.
dashboard.checkupOff: You will see every nearby kitchen. Turn this on any time from Health.
dashboard.checkupOn: Nearby lists now hide plates that clash with this report. Better-matching kitchens are listed first.
dashboard.healthCaloriesPartial: {{kcal}} kcal — some ingredients still need pantry kcal

tour.s1Body: Use your location or pick an address. Nearby kitchens and honest delivery fees start from this pin.
tour.s2Body: Tap a card. Dish photos are live-capture from that kitchen — not stock food ads.
tour.s3Body: Filter veg / non-veg, or turn on “as per my report” after you upload a checkup in My space.
tour.s4Body: Add plates, checkout once. You pay the kitchen — kitchCU does not take a food commission.
tour.s5Body: My orders shows a loader, then tickets. Track when out for delivery. Rate home-taste on delivered orders only. Reorder fills the cart.
tour.s6Body: Account: addresses and UPI for refunds. Dashboard: savings and health. Open /k/CKPNQ001 for a kitchen’s branded menu. Show tips replays this tour.
